record.name: Pitchly: AI Cold Call Coach
record.offering: Business app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Pitchly AI is your personal cold call coach. Practice your pitch, get scored in seconds, and hear exactly how to say it better — so you walk into every real call sharper than the last one.

Record a rep and Pitchly's AI scores your clarity, confidence, pacing, tone, objection handling, and conversion readiness — then gives you the one fix that matters most and speaks the improved line out loud so you hear how it should sound.

KEY FEATURES

• Instant AI Call Feedback
A scored breakdown of delivery, clarity, pacing, and persuasion — including whether you asked for a clear next step — plus the exact rewrite for your weakest moment.

• Hear It Delivered
Don't just read the better line — tap play and hear your AI coach deliver it with the right tone and pacing.

• Objection Gym
Rapid-fire drills against the objections you hear most. One lands, you answer out loud, you get scored — then the next. Train until "no" doesn't rattle you.

• Practice Your Real Prospect
Enter the company and role you're about to call and Pitchly generates that exact buyer to rehearse against — real prep, not a generic script.

• Review a Real Call
Upload a recording or paste a transcript from an actual call for the same AI scorecard, fixes, and coaching you get in practice.

• Live Conversation Mode
Practice against an AI prospect that talks back — real objections, interruptions, and back-and-forth, without burning a real lead.

• Your Real Objections
Teach Pitchly the objections your prospects actually raise, and your personas will throw them at you until your answers are automatic.

• Coach to Your Framework
Score your calls through the methodology your team runs on — SPIN, Challenger, Sandler, MEDDIC, or Gap Selling.

• 7-Day Improvement Plan
A guided first week that takes you from scripted reps to live conversation, with a final scored rep to prove the progress.

• AI Coach Briefings
Cole or Ava reviews your recent sessions and delivers spoken briefings on your trends, weak spots, and what to work on next.

• Teleprompter Mode
Keep your script on screen while you record, then hide it when you're ready to fly without it.

• Rep-Over-Rep Progress
Every session compares against your last rep on the same scenario, so you see the improvement, not just feel it.

• Weekly Recap & Streaks
A "Your Week in Reps" summary, daily streaks, quests, and achievements — plus shareable score cards to show off a big rep.

• Works Where You Work
Start a rep with Siri or the Action Button, watch your timer in the Dynamic Island, and track your streak from Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets.

• Industry-Specific Scenarios
Cold outbound, follow-ups, objection handling, and voicemail — tuned to your industry, offer, and ideal buyer.

WHO IT'S FOR

• Sales reps, SDRs & BDRs ramping faster
• Founders selling their own product
• Real estate, insurance & recruiting professionals
• Anyone who wants to sound confident on a cold call

SUBSCRIPTION & TRIAL

Pitchly is available with a Pitchly Pro subscription. Eligible users can start with a 7-day free trial.

Your trial includes:
• AI pitch feedback, scoring & coaching insights
• The guided 7-day improvement plan
• Live Conversation Mode and deeper AI review as you progress
• Progress tracking, streaks & achievements

Go Pro to keep:
• Practice sessions with daily usage limits
• Full coaching insights, briefings & analytics
• Complete feature access and ongoing updates

Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage your subscription in Account Settings.

record.description_evidence:
Roonly is the AI sales coach built for teams that sell face-to-face. Record in-person conversations, get instant AI analysis, and automatically generate training from your team's real scenarios. Think Gong + Duolingo for field sales.

Most tools stop at recording and analysis. Roonly closes the loop by turning every conversation into personalized training that makes your reps better, automatically, without constant manager oversight.

RECORD
One-tap recording from your iPhone or Apple Watch. Works offline, syncs automatically when you're back online. All-Day Shift Mode captures conversations hands-free so reps never miss a moment. Phone call recording included.

ANALYZE
AI transcribes with speaker separation and scores every conversation automatically. Objections are detected and cataloged. Winning patterns are extracted so you know exactly what's working and what's not. Jump to key moments instantly.

TRAIN AUTOMATICALLY
This is where Roonly pulls ahead. AI builds personalized lessons from your playbook, objection library, and real field data. No more generic training videos. New hires onboard with what actually works at your company.

AI ROLEPLAY THAT ACTUALLY WORKS
Sub 2-second response times. Dynamic voices with real emotion that changes mid-conversation. Hundreds of ICP personas trained on YOUR objections, not generic scripts. When a rep struggles with a real conversation, tap "Try Again" and the AI recreates that exact scenario so they can practice until they nail it.

DUOLINGO-STYLE LESSONS
Bite-sized lessons generated automatically from your team's data. Points, streaks, badges, and leaderboards keep reps engaged. Skill gap detection identifies exactly where each rep needs work, then serves up targeted practice.

SALES REPLAY LIBRARY
Onboard new hires with game film from your top performers' best closes. AI curates the moments that actually matter so new reps learn from real wins, not theory.

AI MANAGER ASSISTANT
Reps ask questions and get instant help with full context on their performance. Managers ask about team trends and get page-aware insights. One manager can effectively coach 10x more reps.

BUILT FOR TEAMS THAT SELL IN PERSON
Roofing & Solar, HVAC & Home Services, Pest Control, Windows & Doors, Automotive Sales, Med Spa & Healthcare, Insurance, and B2B Field Sales.

WHY TEAMS CHOOSE ROONLY

- 40% higher close rates
- 70% faster onboarding
- 10x more reps per manager
- 30% lower rep turnover

Every conversation makes the AI smarter. Better reps create better data, which builds better training. The cycle accelerates automatically.

SourcBuy: AI Factory Shopping
AI Shopping Assistant - Source Verified Global Factories & Save

 How It Works 
1.Share Your Exact Needs  Simply describe the product you’re looking for, or upload an image of your desired item to kickstart the process. 
2.AI Matches Verified Factories  Our intelligent system instantly connects you with rigorously pre-vetted factories across the globe, ensuring you access only qualified suppliers. 
3.Shop with Total Confidence  Enjoy factory-direct pricing, a seamless checkout experience, and reliable international delivery straight to your doorstep. 


Key Benefits
Cost Efficiency at Its Best
Bypass unnecessary intermediaries to access factory-to-consumer pricing, helping you save 20%-50% on every purchase. 
Verified Quality You Can Trust 
Every supplier in our network undergoes strict pre-vetting, so you source products with complete transparency and peace of mind. 
Streamlined Sourcing Experience

Global Reach, Local Convenience 
Discover distinctive, high-quality products from around the world, with hassle-free delivery to your location. 
AI Functionality Notice 
This app leverages AI technology solely for product identification and verified factory matching. All supplier recommendations are based on pre-validated factory data, ensuring accuracy and reliability. 
Ready to shop smarter and save more on global sourcing? 
Download SourcBuy now and experience the future of simplified cross-border shopping!

record.name: ForLater: AI Shopping Wishlist
record.offering: Shopping app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Save what you want from any store into one wishlist. ForLater tracks each price, adds up your total and tells you when something drops, so you can buy later for less.

Smart with AI, private by design. On devices with Apple Intelligence, ForLater reads product pages right on your device: it finds the price when a store hides it, lists the sizes and colors in stock, and suggests which of your lists a new find belongs in. Nothing about the page leaves your device.

Share a product link from Safari, Instagram or any app's share sheet, or paste it in. ForLater pulls in the photo, brand and price and turns it into a card. No more 47 open tabs or a camera roll full of screenshots.

The total of everything you've saved sits at the top of your list, with a chart of how it has grown. Group it by store, brand or month to see where the money would go. Sort by price, date or brand, and search when the list gets long.

Organize with lists. Make lists like Shoes, Gifts or Christmas, add to them from anywhere with a tap or a drag, and show your wishlist one list at a time.

Tap Refresh on any item to check its price again. A sale shows as a strikethrough and a sold-out item is marked on its card. If a store shows a price range or hides the price, type in your own and it counts toward the total straight away.

Bought it? Tap "I bought it!" and it leaves your list and your total. Each item has room for notes, like the size you need or a code a friend sent.

Your list syncs across iPhone, iPad and Mac through your private iCloud account. Save a jacket on your Mac and it's on your phone when you walk into the store.

Your items live on your devices and in your own iCloud, never on our servers. Analytics are anonymous and there is no advertising. ForLater is made by an independent developer in New York.

Questions or ideas: mahanti.corp@gmail.com

Privacy Policy: https://mahanticorp.vercel.app/forlater/privacy-policy

Goods, cars, clothes, services, jobs & apartments: Buy and sell on lalafo AI marketplace in 1000+ categories.

РАЗМЕЩАЙТЕ ВСЕ ВАШИ ТОВАРЫ ЗА СЕКУНДЫ С ИСКУССТВЕННЫМ ИНТЕЛЛЕКТОМ
Размещайте весь свой ассортимент товаров на маркетплейс с одного экрана. Загрузите фото – а искусственный интеллект подберет категорию, параметры и сделает описания за вас. Самые популярные рынки из 1000+ категорий lalafo:

ПРОДАЖА АВТО: НОВЫЕ И Б/У. От надёжных Hyundai и стильных Audi до популярных KIA K5 и легендарных Mercedes W210 и W124. Используйте фильтры по пробегу, типу кузова, объёму и типу двигателя.
НЕДВИЖИМОСТЬ: покупка, продажа, аренда. Снять квартиру на любой срок, сдать квартиру без посредников, найти новостройки от застройщика по выгодным ценам.
ТЕХНИКА И ЭЛЕКТРОНИКА. Популярные модели iPhone, умные часы, телевизоры разных диагоналей и брендов, крупная и мелкая бытовая техника.
МЕБЕЛЬ И ТОВАРЫ ДЛЯ ДОМА. Диваны, кровати, столы и стулья для кухни, гостиной или офиса. Широкий выбор межкомнатных и входных дверей.
СТРОИТЕЛЬСТВО И РЕМОНТ.  Арматура, материалы для кладки кирпича, элементы опалубки, а также всё для отделочных работ — от штукатурки до финишной отделки.
ОДЕЖДА И АКСЕССУАРЫ. Широкий выбор для всей семьи. Мода, шопинг по брендам и все для повседневного гардероба, спорта, отдыха, а также одежда для малышей и школьников.

BÜTÜN MƏHSULLARINIZI SUNİ İNTELLEKT İLƏ SANİYYƏLƏR İÇİNDƏ PAYLAŞIN
Bütün məhsul çeşidinizi bir ekrandan yerləşdirin. Sadəcə şəkil yükləyin — süni intellekt isə kateqoriya seçəcək, parametrləri dolduracaq və sizin əvəzinizə təsvirlər yaradacaq. Saniyələr içində satış edəcəyiniz elanları yaradın və lalafo ilə pul qazanın.

HƏR BÜDCƏ ÜÇÜN MİLYONLARLA MAL VƏ XİDMƏTLƏR
Böyük, kiçik biznes və adi insanların yüz minlərlə məhsul və xidmətləri arasında təkliflər tapın. lalafo-da 1000+ kateqoriyadan ən məhşurları:

MAŞINLARIN SATIŞI: YENİ VƏ İŞLƏNMİŞ. Etibarlı Hyundai və dəbli Audi-dən məşhur KIA K5 və əfsanəvi Mercedes W210 və W124-ə qədər. Yürüş, kuza növü, həcmi və mühərrik növünə görə filtrlərdən istifadə edin.
Əmlak: alqı, satqı, kirayə. İstənilən müddətə mənzil kirayələyin, vasitəçisiz mənzil kirayə verin, münasib qiymətə birbaşa tikinti sahibindən yeni tikililər tapın.
TEXNİKA VƏ ELEKTRONİKA. Populyar iPhone modelləri, smart saatlar, müxtəlif dioqanallı və markalı televizorlar, böyük və kiçik məişət texnikası.
MEBEL VƏ EV ÜÇÜN MALLAR. Mətbəx, qonaq otağı və ya ofis üçün divanlar, çarpayılar, stollar və stullar. Daxili və giriş qapılarının geniş seçimi.
TİKİNTİ VƏ TƏMİR. Armatur, kərpic hörmə materialları, qəlib elementləri, eləcə də bitirmə işləri üçün hər şey — suvaqdan bitirməyə qədər.
Geyim və AKSESUARLAR. Bütün ailə üçün geniş seçim. Moda, brendlərin alış-verişi və gündəlik qarderob üçün hər şey, idman, istirahət, həmçinin körpələr və məktəblilər üçün geyimlər.

POSTAVITE PROIZVODE ZA NEKOLIKO SEKUNDI UZ POMOĆ AI
Postavite čitav asortiman proizvoda sa jedne stranice. Samo dodajte fotografije – naša AI tehnologija će izabrati odgovarajuću kategoriju, popuniti detalje i napisati opis umesto vas. Kreirajte oglase koji prodaju za nekoliko sekundi i počnite da zarađujete sa lalafo. Najpopularnije u preko 1000 kategorija na lalafo:

NEKRETNINE: KUPOVINA, PRODAJA, IZDAVANJE. Iznajmite stan na bilo koji period, oglasite nekretninu bez posrednika, ili pronađite novogradnju direktno od investitora. 
TEHNIKA I ELEKTRONIKA. Aktuelni modeli iPhone telefona, pametni satovi, televizori svih veličina i brendova, i veliki izbor kućnih aparata.
NAMEŠTAJ I OPREMA ZA KUĆU. Kauči, kreveti, stolovi i stolice za kuhinju, dnevnu sobu ili kancelariju. Plus, veliki izbor sobnih i ulaznih vrata.
GRAĐEVINA I RENOVIRANJE. Armature, materijali za zidanje, elementi za oplatu, kao i sve što je potrebno za završne radove — od maltera do tapeta i lakova.
ODEĆA I AKSESOARI. Veliki izbor za celu porodicu. Moda, brendirana garderoba, svakodnevna odeća, sportska odeća, pidžame, i garderoba za bebe i školarce.

record.description_evidence:
Mevara is an AI shopping assistant and price comparison app for iPhone. Search across retailers, compare prices and unit value, check delivery estimates, and keep your purchase history on your phone.

SEARCH ONCE, COMPARE STORES

Search supported retailers together and browse products as they arrive. Filter by store, review the options and open the live retailer listing when you are ready.

COMPARE PRICE, SIZE AND DELIVERY

Different package sizes can make prices hard to compare. Mevara helps compare unit value where product data supports it, alongside price and delivery estimates. Tap Compare for a focused view of the available offers.

ASK ABOUT YOUR RESULTS

Ask Mevara can help you find products, understand the results on your screen, explore saved spending and organize Restock. Ask a question in your own words and use the answer to decide what to look at next.

KEEP YOUR PURCHASE HISTORY

Save a purchase after buying to remember the product, store, price and date. Your saved purchases stay on your iPhone and help Mevara recognize products you have bought before.

KNOW WHEN TO RESTOCK

Keep track of everyday essentials, see what is running low or due soon, and plan what to buy again. Restock uses the purchases you save to help estimate timing.

BUY FROM THE RETAILER

Open the live product page to review the current offer. Checkout and payment stay with the retailer. Mevara does not place orders or process payments.

PRIVATE SHOPPING MEMORY

No Mevara account is required. Your purchase history and Restock items are saved on your iPhone. Retailer sign in happens on the retailer's website.

Ask Mevara uses OpenAI through Mevara's secure service. Only after you allow AI sharing, Mevara sends your question and selected shopping information relevant to the request. It does not upload your complete purchase database. You can change AI sharing at any time in Settings.

Prices, availability and delivery estimates come from retailers and can change. Some stores may require sign in or verification. Mevara is independent and is not affiliated with the retailers it displays.

record.description_evidence:
Listonic is the best shared grocery list app for families, couples, and housemates who want an easier way to plan shopping together.

Add products as soon as you think of them, see changes made by others in real time, and always have the latest version of your list with you. Listonic helps your household remember what to buy, avoid duplicate purchases, and spend less time coordinating shopping through messages.

Your lists are available across supported phones, tablets, and computers. You can also use Listonic offline - any changes will sync automatically when you reconnect.

WHY LISTONIC?

Listonic keeps everyone involved in shopping on the same page. One person can add a product from home while another checks it off at the store, so the whole household always knows what is still needed.

Smart organization makes even a long grocery list easier to follow. Products can be grouped by aisle, helping you move through the store more efficiently without returning to sections you have already visited.

BUILT FOR
- Families who want to manage household shopping in one place
- Couples who share shopping and want to avoid buying the same products twice
- Housemates who need a simple way to coordinate shared purchases
- People who want to replace paper notes and shopping-related messages with one current list
- Anyone who wants to remember everything and complete their shopping more efficiently

WHAT YOU CAN DO
- Share lists in real time, so everyone can work from the latest version
- Add, edit, and check off products together, making it clear what has already been purchased
- Group products by aisle to spend less time walking back and forth through the store
- Sort products alphabetically or create your own order to shop in the way that works best for you
- Add items using voice input when typing is inconvenient
- Find products quickly in the extensive catalog and prepare lists in less time
- Receive notifications when someone updates a shared list
- Use the AI Assistant to plan meals, discover recipes, and turn ideas into products to buy
- Continue using your list offline and synchronize changes when your connection returns

WHAT MAKES IT USEFUL?

Listonic gives your household one reliable place for grocery planning. There is no need to combine paper lists, separate notes, and repeated messages about what is missing.
By keeping products organized and updates visible to everyone, Listonic helps you forget fewer items, reduce unnecessary purchases, and make everyday shopping feel more manageable.

MINI FAQ

Why is Listonic the best grocery list app? 
Listonic combines real-time multi-device syncing, offline reliability, automated aisle sorting, budget tracking, and an AI meal planner into one simple, user-friendly app.

Can I use Listonic offline?
Yes. Your lists remain available without an internet connection. You can add, edit, and check off products, and your changes will sync automatically when you reconnect.

Can several people edit the same list?
Yes. Share a list with other Listonic users, and everyone can add, edit, or check off products. Updates appear in real time across connected devices, helping you avoid buying the same item twice.

Can I organize products my own way?
Yes. You can group products by aisle, sort them alphabetically, or arrange them in a custom order. This makes it easier to follow the list in the way that best matches how you shop.

Start using Listonic and keep your household’s grocery shopping organized in one shared place.
